title: manual BG checks keep replicating in Treatments
symptom: Manual BG checks added via xDrip and uploaded to Nightscout are repeatedly synced by both nsclient and AAPS itself, causing duplicate entries in the Treatments list that keep reappearing even after deletion.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. A maintainer suggests that only one app should upload to NS and that data from multiple apps are not fully compatible, but this is not confirmed as the cause.
fix: No definitive fix is provided. The maintainer advises that only one app should upload to NS, but this is not a confirmed resolution.
evidence_quote: only one app must upload to NS, all other configurations usually lead to troubles you see
